verdict.rationale: Figma Make's marketing says builds are "visually editable" and that you can move between code and canvas, which suggests direct, prompt-free editing. Users can also edit the app's code directly. The docs do not describe selecting an element and changing its text, style, or layout. Annotations and the draw tool still route changes through the agent. Missing for 10: documented select-to-edit for text, style and layout properties, details of the visual editing controls, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip

citations.quote: Everything you build is code-backed and visually editable, so you can easily jump between code and canvas.
